rule_text: Search OFBiz installation directories (C:\*ofbiz*\*\webapp\ROOT\, C:\opt\ofbiz\*\webapp\) for .jsp web shell artifacts (CVE-2024-38856).
rationale: OFBiz is a non-default Java application not covered by standard Windows file-search catalogs; JSP artifacts in its webapp root are high-confidence post-RCE persistence indicators missed because the directory path was absent from extraction locations.

rule_text: Scheduled tasks executing credential-extraction utilities (wmic, whoami, net user, secretsdump) or WMI queries for account enumeration should be flagged as attacker_persistence (CISA AA24-109A).
rationale: Teaches INTERPRET to recognize Akira-style credential-harvesting tasks by behavioral pattern, catching obfuscated or non-obvious task names that would otherwise be dismissed as benign automation.
